text: Settlement screen: Build House button is greyed out with no cost shown (Farm cost is listed under Buildings, Stall cost only in objective). Hovering shows no tooltip; player can't tell what a House needs. Tick ~5626.

While the 'A bountiful harvest' world event sheet is open (world paused, tps 0), pressing E next to a tree still runs the interaction and shows 'Gathered 0 wood from tree. (x6)'. Expected E to be ignored (or the sheet to swallow input). Also the objective reads 'Wood 16/20' while inventory has 20 wood. Tick 9802.

Objective 7 'Reach the Village era' progress bar text is clipped on the left: reads 'mbers 3/10 • Buildings 2/2'. Also the objective says 'Buildings 2/2' while the era panel lists 'Stalls 2/2' — different words for the same requirement? Tick 12903.

After 4 houses + 1 farm the settlement screen says 'The settlement is now a Town!' / 'TOWN OF WESTHAM' while the nation era is still Camp and Village era isn't reached. Settlement tiers share names with eras (Village, Town), which is confusing. Also 'Build here with what you carry' while houses were paid from the stockpile with an empty inventory. Tick ~14700.

Courting a Stranger (Yvonne Thomas): R said 'I don't even know you. (needs Acquaintance)'. It took 4 talks + 4 ten-coin gifts before R worked ('joined Westham! Members: 7'), but no relationship meter or progress toward Acquaintance is shown anywhere, so the player can't tell how close they are. Tick 17501.

Village era reached at tick 26852 (537 s game): era_changed Camp->Village, +100 coins, unlocks Storehouse/Workshop/3 settlements. Requirement timeline: Village(settlement) 1/1 and Stalls 2/2 at tick 12871; Day 2 began ~tick 20990; Members 10/10 last, at 26852 (Bella Taylor joined). Members was the binding constraint; only 1 of 10 came from my own courting, the rest drifted in via housing.
